record.description: Iisaak Forest Resources Ltd. is an innovative First Nations led forest services company operating exclusively with Clayoquot Sound, British Columbia. Iisaak Forest Resources is committed to Hishuk-ish tsawalk (pronounced He-shook ish sha-walk), the Nuu-chah-nulth belief of respecting the limits of what is extracted and the interconnectedness of all things.
